description.value: Habitual Wellness Club & Café sits on the east shore of Mill Lake in Abbotsford, tucked just off the park boardwalk beside the Kariton Art Gallery. The café serves entirely plant-based, gluten-free coffee, matcha, superfood smoothies, and housemade snacks from a spacious lakeside patio. An adjoining outdoor Wellness Club offers drop-in yoga, Pilates, run club, and bodyweight fitness classes in the open air of Mill Lake Park.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (9 spaces) at 30m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, open business at Mill Lake Park in Abbotsford, with consistent phone number and street address versus OSM, though the postal code differs (OSM: V2S 1V9; website contact page: V2S 6B1). The café menu page explicitly states it is dairy-free, gluten-free, refined-sugar-free, seed oil-free, and peanut-free, with vegan options available, and online ordering is offered. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V2S 1V9 but website contact page shows V2S 6B1. Street address and unit number are otherwise consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café and wellness club at Mill Lake Park with a confirmed website and clear public access. The plant-forward, allergen-free menu and lakeside patio make it a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Café page states menu is entirely free from dairy, gluten, seed oils, peanuts, and refined sugar; website notes 'Vegan or gluten-free? Ask us what you can have on the menu, and prepare to be blown away.'

wow_evidence: east shore of Mill Lake... tucked just off the park boardwalk beside the Kariton Art Gallery... adjoining outdoor Wellness Club offers drop-in yoga, Pilates, run club
